paite: Huchih lai a mipi sang tampi kiphu mawimawi zou hial a ahong kikhop un, Jesu'n amasapen in anungzuite kiang ah, "Pharisaite silngou, lepchiahna lak ah pilvang un,
heading: Nungzuite Thuhilhna / (Mat 10.26-27)
english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

paite: kilang lou ding a selguk bangmah a-om kei a; theih louh ding a iim leng bangmah a-om sam kei hi.
english: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

paite: Huaiziak in mial a na gen peuh uh vak a zak in a-om ding; dantan sunggil a bilbul a na thugen uh intung vum ah tangkoupih in a-om ding hi.
english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

paite: "Huan ka lawmte aw, ka hon hilh ahi, pumpi that a, huai nung a bangmah dang hih nawn theiloute zaw, kihta kei un,
heading: Lauh Ding Pen / (Mat 10.28-31)
english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

paite: Himahleh kua ahia na lauh ding uh ka hon hilhkhol ahi; ahihlup nung a leng Gehenna a paihtheihna thuneipa lau un.
english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

paite: "Dal dangka nih in kawlgit nga azuak sek kei ua hia? Himahleh alak ua khat leng Pathian in amangngilh ngei kei hi.
english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

paite: Na luzang ua samzangte nangawn leng sim vek ahi uh. Lau kei un; kawlgit tampi sang in na manphazaw uhi.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

paite: "Huan ka hon hilh ahi, mite ma a hon gum peuhmah Pathian angelte ma ah Mihing Tapa in agum sam ding hi.
heading: Khrist Gum Leh Gum Lou / (Mat 10.32-33; 12.32; 10.19-20)
english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

paite: Himahleh mite ma a hon kitheihmohbawl peuhmah Pathian angelte ma ah ka kitheihmohbawl sam ding hi.
english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

paite: Mihing Tapa kalh a thu gen peuhmah agenkalhna ngaihdamsak ahi ding a; himahleh Kha Siangthou hilhial gensia zaw agensiatna ngaihdamsak ahi kei ding.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

paite: "Sinagog a mite, vaihawmte, heutute ma a ahon pi hun chiang un, bangchi in bang thu in ka dawng dia, bang thu ka gen dia chi in lungkham kei un.
english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

paite: Huai huntak in, bang ahia na gen ding uh, Kha Siangthou in ahon hilh ding hi,” achi hi.
english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

paite: Mipi lak a khat in Jesu kiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ka u kiang ah gou hon hawm sam ding in hilh in," achi hi.
heading: Mihau Hai Gentehna
english: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang ah, "Mihing, noumau tung ah kua'n ahia kei thukhenpa hiam tan seppa hiam a hon bawl?" achi hi.
english: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

paite: Akiang uah, "Pilvang unla, enna lak ah kiveng un; hauhna mihing damsan ahi kei," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

paite: Huan akiang uah gentehna thu agen a, "Mihau kuahiam ahong pung mahmah hi.
english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

paite: Huchi in akingaihtuah a, bangchibang in ka hih diam aw? Ka buh-le-bal koihkhawmna ding ka nei kei hi.
english: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

paite: Hichibang in ka hih ding e, 'ka buh innte ka phel ding a, asang a lianzaw in ka lam dia, huai ah buh leh ka van tengteng ka koihkhawm ding.'
english: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

paite: Huan ka kha kiang ah, 'Kha aw, kum tampi sung daih ding tampi na kholta; khawl inla, ne in dawn inla, nuamtak in om in, ka chi ding,' achi hi.
english: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

paite: Himahleh, Pathian in akiang ah, 'Nang mihai, tuzan chiah na kha ahon laksak ding uh, huai na lamkhiakte, kua a ahita dia?'
english: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

paite: Amau a dia gou khol a, Pathian lam a hauloute huchi ahi uh," achi hi.
english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

paite: Huan anungzuite kiang ah, "Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, bang ka ne diam aw? chi in na hinna thu uh leh bang silh in ka teng diam aw? chi in na pumpi thu uah lunghimoh kei un.
heading: Pathian Muanna / (Mat 6.25-34)
english: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

paite: Nek ding sang in hinna athupizawa, puansilh sang in leng pumpi athupizaw hi.
english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

paite: Va-akte ngaihtuah dih uh, buh atuh kei ua, a-at sam kei uh; buhpang leh buh inn leng anei kei uh; himahleh Pathian in amaute avak hi; noute vasate sang a manphazaw na hi uh.
english: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

paite: Huan nou lak ah lunghimoh ziak a kua'n ahia ama dunglam tong khat a hihsang thei tuan?
english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

paite: Hiai lel leng hihtheiloute'n bangziak a thil dang lunghimoh nak na hi ua?
english: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

paite: Lilite khandan ngaihtuah dih uh; nna asem kei ua, khau leng akhek kei uh; himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Solomon hilhial leng athupina tengteng a akizep in, hiai lilite lak a khat tuk in zep in a-om kei hi.
english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

paite: Huchi in gamlak loupa tuni a hing a, azing a thukkhuk a khul nawn mai ding bawn Pathian in hichi tel a azepleh, aw nou mi gintawmte, huaite sang in puansilh hon pe zaw na tel in chia!
english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

paite: Huan na nek ding uh, na dawn ding uh, zong kei un; ginglel in leng om sam kei un.
english: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

paite: Khovel a namte'n huai thil tengteng azong uh; huai bang na kiphamoh uh chih na Pa un atheigige hi.
english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

paite: Himahleh Pathian kumpigam zong zaw un, huchi in huai thilte leng ahon piak behlap ding hi.
english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

paite: "Pawltawmte aw, lau kei un; nou kiang a gam piak ding na Pa uh kipah lamtak ahi.
heading: Van Hauhsakna / (Mat 6.19-21)
english: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

paite: Na neih peuh uh zuak unla, migentheite kiang ah pia un; van ah guta naih phaklouhna ah, leikha in aneksiatlouhna ah, dangka ip lui theiloute, gou bei theiloute kibawl un.
english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

paite: Na gou omna peuh ua na lungtang uh leng a-om ding ziak in.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

paite: "Na kawng uh gak unla, na khawnvak uh leng desa diam in om un.
heading: Sikha Kiging Gigete
english: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

paite: Mi'n apu uh kitenna ankuangluina a kipan ahong pai chiang a, kongkhak ahon kiuhtak a, hon thei pah ding a angak nilouh bang in, om un.
english: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

paite: Apu uh ahong pai chiang in sikha na ngak nilouh a, amuhte ahampha uh; chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ama'n akawng agak dia, amau an um ding in atusak ding a, a-nna uh asepsak ding hi.
english: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

paite: Zan lai in hiam, thoh hun in hiam a hong a, huchibang a ahon muh, huai sikhate ahampha uhi.
english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

paite: "Himahleh, hiai thei un, guta ahong pai ding inn neipa'n theileh aveng dia, a-inn aphenvangsak kei ding hi.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

paite: Nou leng mansa in om un, na gintak louh dak un Mihing Tapa ahong pai ding hi,” achi hi.
english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

paite: Huan Peter in, "Toupa, hiai gentehna koumau kia hia na hon hilh, mi tengteng?" achi hi.
heading: Sikha Ginom Leh Ginom Lou Tehna / (Mat 24.45-51)
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

paite: Toupa'n, "Sumkempa ginom, piltak, apu in ahun teng a atan ding uh hawmsak ding a a-inkuanpihte tung a heutu a abawl ding kua pen ahi dia le?"
english: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

paite: Apu hong pai chiang in sikha huchibang a hih a hon muh dingpa ahampha hi.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

paite: Diktak in ka hon hilh ahi, aneih tengteng tung a heutu ding in abawl ding hi.
english: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

paite: Himahleh huai sikha in alungtang in, "Ka pu ahong zok kei ding e," chi in asikhanu, asikhapa, na vo taleh ne in dawn in na kham taleh;
english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

paite: huai sikha pu, agin louh ni, atheih louh lai in ahong ding a, tum nih ahon suah ding a, miginomloute tan bang atangsak ding hi.
english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

paite: Sikha apu deihlam theigige napi a na kiging tuan lou a, apu deihlam a gamta loupa'n nakpitak a vuak atuak ding hi.
english: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

paite: Himahleh theiloupi a vuakna tham a gamtapa'n awlchik a vuak atuak ding. Tampi piak a ommi kiang ah tampi phut in a-om ding a; tampi kepsakpa kiang ah atamsem aphut ding uhi.
english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

paite: "Khovel a mei khesuk ding a hong pai ka hi; tu in leng kang pahleh chi na tel ing e!
heading: Jesu Kikhekna Bul / (Mat 10.34-36)
english: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

paite: Himahleh baptisma tan ding ka nei, huai ka hihtangtun mateng ka om nuam lou hi na mahmah e;
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

paite: khovel a lem lengsak ding a hong pai hiam hon sa na hi uh maw? Hi dek lou hial, ka hon hilh ahi, kikhenna lengsak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw.
english: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

paite: Tunung chiang in inkuan khat ah mi nga akidou ding uh, thum in nih, nih in thum.
english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

paite: Akidou ding ua, pa in atapa, atapa in apa; anu in atanu, atanu in anu; atekpi in amou, amou in atekpi," achi hi.
english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

paite: Huan mipi kiang ah leng, "Tumlam a mei kai na muh uleh, 'vuah azu ding na chi pah ua; huan ahong zu ngei zel hi.'
heading: Hun Chiamtehna / (Mat 16.2-3)
english: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

paite: Sim huih nung na muh chiang un, 'khua alum ding, na chi ua, ahong lum hi.'
english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

paite: Nou lepchiahte aw, khovel leh van omdan leng na genchian thei ngal ua, bang achia tu hun theichian siam lou na hi ua?
english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

paite: "Bang achia noumau in thudik kikhen lou na hi ua?
heading: Na Langpa Toh Kilem In / (Mat 5.25-26)
english: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

paite: Hon hekpa toh thukhenpa kiang na zot lai un, lampi ah kileptheihna khat zong teitei in; huchi lou in zaw thukhenpa mai ah hon kailut ding a, thukhenpa'n miman heutu ahon mansak ding a, miman heutupa'n suangkul ah ahon khum kha ding hi.
english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, paihsa san khat nangawn na piak kim masiah, huai a kipan na pawt kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”
